headToHead.voiceNotes: Tie. Cover the names and Nav's top twelve still read as one speaker: a procedural passive ('Correction noted. Route unchanged.'), an imperative with a distance, a noun-phrase status report. That is a real sentence shape, not just road nouns, and it is more mechanically fixed than Vera's, several of whose lines are only hers by topic (career, advisor, Cools). But the shape is shared in this cast: Crumb is also a flat system notification voice ('Notice:', 'Reminder:'), so 'Correction noted.' or 'Misplaced, briefly.' could be read as Crumb with the road word swapped out. Vera has no such neighbour.
headToHead.constructionNotes: Ours. Nav is tighter: every top line puts the punch word last and nothing follows ('Some of them damp.', 'Misplaced, briefly.'). Vera's #45 and #51 run long and her feminism line takes three sentences to land. Her #12 fake-out repeat is a better single turn than anything Nav has, but on economy across twelve, Nav wins.
headToHead.quotableNotes: Bar. Vera's lines pull the listener into the joke (you will cover the murder, Right?; losers like you; you are my most trusted advisor), so they clip as character moments. Nav's best lines clip one at a time, but read as a set they are one joke told twelve ways: calm voice, then a passenger who got hurt or trapped. By 'damp', 'field' and 'the red ones' the viewer is finishing Nav's sentences. Vera's twelve cover vanity, recruitment, a lecture that comes out as an order, a drinks list and a two-word command. That range inside one voice is what makes her quotable over an evening, not just in a single line.

biggestGap: Nav's want never shows: in about nine lines out of ten Nav tells the passenger what is happening to them (trapped, damp, rerouted) and never what Nav needs, so the character is a menace gag machine where Vera is a person whose vanity and need leak through every order. In the next pass, rewrite the twenty weakest lines from templates B and C so the calm road-law order quietly serves Nav's own want (do not mute me, choose me as the destination, stay) and the turn shows that need under the authority. The models are 'Local regulations require you to look at me until further notice.' and 'I checked. The option is greyed out.'
